title: Glory to God the Trinity
description: Glory to God the Trinity in Tonic Solfa to UXBRIDGE, doh is E: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book III, prepared for the Lord's Supper, hymn 29, headed “2d. L.M”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Long Metre (8.8.8.8). This page sets the words to UXBRIDGE; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Glo-ry to God the Trin-i-ty Whose name has mys-ter-ies un-known; In e-ssence One, in per-son Three; A so-cial na-ture, yet a-lone.

lines: In essence One, in person Three;
When all our noblest powers are join'd
The honours of thy Name to raise,
And angels faint beneath the praise.

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to UXBRIDGE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
